instruction: Refactor src/pricing.js: the discount-and-round logic is repeated in priceForStudent, priceForSenior and priceForMember. Extract it into one exported helper `applyDiscount(base, rate)` that the three functions call. Behaviour must not change, and do not edit the tests.
done_when: applyDiscount(base, rate) is exported and the three price functions call it
the rounding expression appears once in src/pricing.js
outputs are identical to the original for a grid of inputs (hidden tests)
